correctness.rationale: The complete 1024-subset enumeration agrees between independent DFS and union-find tests; lex matching has 389 pairs and exactly one 0-cell and six 5-cells. Directed Hasse orientation has 3470 covers and topological sort of all 785 nodes, proving acyclicity. Forman then gives six integral five-spheres. Independent mod-two reduction finds beta5=6 and signed permutation traces agree on every one of 120 automorphisms with the exterior square standard-module formula. Code and output are embedded.

value.rationale: The vertex-induced acyclic-subgraph complex is a canonical topological refinement of the vertex-feedback-set/decycling problem. This calculates the full integral homotopy and nontrivial irreducible symmetry character for the Petersen graph, a minimal symmetric cubic graph with overlapping cycles, outside previously inspected cactus and product classifications. The shared exterior-square character with the degree-shifted cut complex poses a precise comparison problem. The example is a natural complete topological invariant, not an arbitrary parameter slice or mod-two-only computation.
